label: Certiorari granted
caption: DEPT. OF EDUCATION, ET AL. V. BROWN, MYRA, ET AL.
text: Consideration of the application for stay presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court is deferred pending oral argument. The application for stay is also treated as a petition for a writ of certiorari before judgment, and the petition is granted. The parties are directed to brief and argue the following questions: (1) Whether respondents have Article III standing; and (2) Whether the Department’s plan is statutorily authorized and was adopted in a procedurally proper manner. The Clerk is directed to establish a briefing schedule that will allow the case to be argued in the February 2023 argument session.
